description: Client types derived from the server's code or contract, so breaking API changes become compile errors in the frontend.
`export type AppType = typeof app` of a chained Hono app: carries every route's inputs and outputs for the RPC client.
Hono's RPC client from `hono/client`: `hc<AppType>(baseUrl, { fetch? })` exposes routes as typed methods (`client.todos.$post({ json })`).
A Zod schema imported by both server (request validation) and client (form validation), so both enforce the same rules.
Imports only types; erased at compile time, so server code never reaches the client bundle.
Checking `response.status === 201` narrows the type of `response.json()` to the body returned with that status.
Generating typed clients from an OpenAPI document, the cross-language alternative to RPC types.
